environment.description: Kubernetes 1.27 cluster where the namespace 'data-pipeline' has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Pod Security Admission controller in enforce mode). Additionally, a ValidatingAdmissionPolicy (CEL-based, v1beta1) is configured with expression: object.spec.containers.all(c, !has(c.securityContext.privileged) || c.securityContext.privileged == false) && object.spec.volumes.all(v, !has(v.hostPath)). The stream-processor ServiceAccount is bound to a Role with only 'get' on its own namespace secrets. Network policy restricts egress to only the downstream gRPC service on port 9090 and Kafka brokers on port 9092. Note: the Kafka topic still accepts messages from any authenticated producer, and the gRPC metadata injection path in the code remains as-is.
